body:
Ive been Trying to get alprazolam, valiums, or lorezapam for an anxiety problem. The docter gives me lexapro to start on.
Ive taken lexapro in up to 80mg (8 10mg pills) with poor recreational effects only effect is a mild euphoria.
Been ussually taking it once daily. After awhile u build up a very mild euphoria. Lexapro IS NOT a sedative which makes it poor for recreational use.
